newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 27.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Taichung, Keelung harbours set to launch transshipment scheme.
Leftists win first round of elections in France.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Japanese patrol boats intercept Taiwan, Hong Kong protest boats near disputed East China Sea archipelago.
French Prime Minister Alain Juppe will resign after leftists take lead in elections.
LIBERTY TIMES - Twelve county and city mayors ask Premier Lien Chan for financial aids.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Economics ministry decides to halt mine exploration grants in western Taiwan.
Communist China to take much time in unifying Hong Kong and mainland currencies.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - President Lee Teng-hui expresses concern over reports of communist China investigating potential tax evasion by Taiwan investors on mainland.
Central bank to seek participation for Taiwan in economic cooperation projects in southeast Asia.
